after.description:
Requests a Copilot code review for a pull request. Every call expresses intent to start a
new review: if no Copilot review has been requested yet, an initial request is created; if
the most recent Copilot review has already completed (including if it was later dismissed or
superseded), a new request is created automatically to continue the review lifecycle. If a
Copilot code review request is already pending for the pull request, no new request is
created and the response is `409`.

If the actor or repository is not eligible for Copilot code review, the actor has no quota
remaining, or the licensing organization is unavailable, no request is created and the
response is `422` with a stable `failure_reason`. A `review_effort` is accepted only when that
effort level is available for the repository and actor; an unrecognized or unavailable
`review_effort` returns `422` with `failure_reason` `INVALID_REVIEW_EFFORT`. If
the actor, repository owner, or requesting application owner has been flagged, the response
is `403` with `failure_reason` `ACTOR_FLAGGED`. If the per-actor or per-owner request rate
limit is exceeded, the response is `429` with `failure_reason` `RATE_LIMITED`. If Copilot
code review cannot be serviced right now, the response is `503`.

Existing human and team review requests on the pull request are left unchanged.

default.summary: Request a review with a specific effort level

review_effort.description: The effort level to use for the Copilot code review. Omit to use the default effort level. Only effort levels available for the repository and actor are accepted. For more information, see [Review effort level](https://docs.github.com/copilot/concepts/agent-capabilities/agent-powered-workflows-and-operations/code-review#review-effort-level).

default.summary: A Copilot code review request was created

403.description: Forbidden. `failure_reason` is `ACTOR_FLAGGED` when the actor, repository owner, or requesting application owner has been flagged; it is absent for other authorization failures.

409.description: Conflict, a Copilot code review request is already pending for this pull request

422.description: Validation failed. `failure_reason` is present for a stable business denial (the actor or repository is not eligible, the actor has no quota remaining, or the licensing organization is unavailable) and absent when the request body fails generic request validation. `failure_reason` is `INVALID_REVIEW_EFFORT` when the requested `review_effort` is unrecognized or not available for the repository and actor, and `message` lists the available effort levels.

429.description: Too many requests. The per-actor or per-owner Copilot code review request rate limit has been exceeded. `failure_reason` is `RATE_LIMITED`.

503.description: Service unavailable, Copilot code review cannot be serviced right now

after.summary: Request a Copilot code review for a pull request

after.description:
List issues in a repository. Only open issues will be listed.

> [!NOTE]
> GitHub's REST API considers every pull request an issue, but not every issue is a pull request. For this reason, "Issues" endpoints may return both issues and pull requests in the response. You can identify pull requests by the `pull_request` key. Be aware that the `id` of a pull request returned from "Issues" endpoints will be an _issue id_. To find out the pull request id, use the "[List pull requests](https://docs.github.com/rest/pulls/pulls#list-pull-requests)" endpoint.

This endpoint supports the following custom media types. For more information, see "[Media types](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/getting-started-with-the-rest-api#media-types)."

- **`application/vnd.github.raw+json`**: Returns the raw markdown body. Response will include `body`. This is the default if you do not pass any specific media type.
- **`application/vnd.github.text+json`**: Returns a text only representation of the markdown body. Response will include `body_text`.
- **`application/vnd.github.html+json`**: Returns HTML rendered from the body's markdown. Response will include `body_html`.
- **`application/vnd.github.full+json`**: Returns raw, text, and HTML representations. Response will include `body`, `body_text`, and `body_html`.

parameters.description: If an `integer` is passed, it should refer to a milestone by its `number` field. If the string `*` is passed, issues with any milestone are accepted. If the string `none` is passed, issues without milestones are returned.
parameters.name: milestone

parameters.description: Indicates the state of the issues to return.
parameters.name: state

parameters.description: Can be the name of a user. Pass in `none` for issues with no assigned user, and `*` for issues assigned to any user.
parameters.name: assignee

parameters.description: Can be the name of an issue type. If the string `*` is passed, issues with any type are accepted. If the string `none` is passed, issues without type are returned.
parameters.name: type

parameters.description: The user that created the issue.
parameters.name: creator

parameters.description: A user that's mentioned in the issue.
parameters.name: mentioned

parameters.description:
A comma-separated list of issue field filters in `field_slug:value` format.
Only issues matching all specified field values are returned.
Requires issue fields to be enabled for the repository. Issue fields are
not available for user-owned repositories, and field availability for
organization-owned public repositories depends on the organization's
visibility settings. For example, `priority:Urgent,severity:High` filters
issues where the `priority` field is `Urgent` AND the `severity` field is
`High`.
parameters.name: issue_field_values

parameters.description: What to sort results by.
parameters.name: sort
